can_convert = True
while m != 0:
    mod = m % w
    if mod == 0 or mod == 1:
        m //= w
    elif mod == w - 1:
        m = (m + 1) // w
    else:
        print("NO")
        can_convert = False
        break

if can_convert:
    print("YES")
